pages.title: Intro
pages.body: 52 thousand years ago, the black hole at the center of our galaxy, Sagittarius A*, collided with another. The immense pressure combined with the extreme warping of spacetime as they got closer created a material so dense, it had no other choice but to molecularly form as a crystal like substance. When the black holes finally merged, the energy released sent gravitational waves, as well as fragments of the crystal like substance flying out in all directions at 50% the speed of light! Some of those fragments shot straight at us, and it appears they have arrived. Some fragments get slowed down by the other planets in our Solar System before reaching us, but most of them don't. As the ultra dense fragments crash into the earth, they burrow deep underground, unscathed. "Hmmm" you think to yourself, "I wonder if that material could be useful."... There's only 1 way to find out.

pages.title: How Infinium Works
pages.subtitle: The road from fragment to Infinity
pages.body:
Find Spacetime Fragments and turn them into crystals.
Crystals make Infinium Ingots. Ingots and upgrade templates turn netherite armor into your first set.
Charge that set with crystals, then upgrade it to tier 2. Combine both tier 2 lines to make Infinity.
pages.caption: Fragments, crystal, ingot, armor, upgrade, Infinity

pages.title: Spacetime Fragments
pages.subtitle: Where it all starts
pages.body:
Fragments are the base of everything in this mod.
Look in structure chests. The Nether, the End and ancient structures hide the most. Villages rarely have any.
Dungeons and meteor craters have them too.
pages.caption: Spacetime Fragments

pages.title: Roguelike Dungeons
pages.subtitle: Deep floors, better loot
pages.body:
Dungeons are full of fragments and templates.
The deeper the floor, the better the loot.
Chests you loot fill up again after a while, so come back later.
pages.caption: Dungeon loot refills
pages.numbers: Numbers: chests refill {n:dungeon_refill_days} days after you loot them.

pages.title: Dungeon Finder
pages.subtitle: Point the way down
pages.body:
Put 8 bones around a compass.
Hold it to point at the nearest dungeon. Beams of light show over dungeon entrances.
The beam color tells you how big the dungeon is.
pages.caption: Crafting table

pages.title: Meteor Showers
pages.subtitle: Look up, then take cover
pages.body:
Every so often a meteor shower comes at night. You get a warning first.
Meteors fall near players. A direct hit hurts through any armor, so get under a roof.
Afterwards, loot the craters for fragments and, very rarely, a template.
pages.caption: A meteor shower
pages.numbers: Numbers: every {n:meteor_min_days}-{n:meteor_max_days} nights, {n:meteor_warning_min} minute warning, a hit costs {n:meteor_hit_hearts} heart. Each meteor has a {n:meteor_loot} chance to drop {n:meteor_frag_min}-{n:meteor_frag_max} fragments; templates {n:meteor_tpl_t1} (tier 1) and {n:meteor_tpl_t2} (tier 2).

pages.title: Upgrade Templates
pages.subtitle: The shape of your armor
pages.body:
Templates are in the same chests as fragments, but rarer. Very rarely a meteor drops one.
Astral and Cybernetic templates are the common ones. Singularity and Cyber Psycho templates are rare.
pages.caption: Each template sets an armor line

pages.title: Spacetime Crystals
pages.subtitle: Power for your armor
pages.body:
Put 8 fragments around an amethyst shard to make a crystal {C}.
Crystals make ingots, and they charge your armor to unlock its perks.
pages.caption: Crafting table

pages.title: Infinium Ingot
pages.subtitle: Used in every Infinium craft
pages.body:
A crystal goes in the middle, netherite on the sides, obsidian on top and bottom.
The four corners take an Eye of Ender, a Diamond Block, a Wither Skeleton Skull and a Redstone Block, in any order.
pages.caption: Crafting table

pages.title: Your First Set
pages.subtitle: Pick a path
pages.body:
At a smithing table, use a template, a netherite piece and an ingot.
Astral suits builders and explorers. Cybernetic suits fighters and miners.
Changed your mind? Use the other template on a piece to swap it. The template is used up.
pages.caption: Smithing table: make, or swap lines

pages.title: How Tiers Work
pages.subtitle: Tier 1, tier 2, Infinity
pages.body:
Tier 1 is Astral or Cybernetic.
Tier 2: upgrade a fully charged tier 1 piece. Astral becomes Singularity, Cybernetic becomes Cyber Psycho.
A tier 2 piece counts as fully charged tier 1. It keeps every tier 1 perk at full strength. Crystals then upgrade those perks.
Tier 3: combine a Singularity piece with the same Cyber Psycho piece and an ingot to make Infinity. It counts as both lines fully charged and upgrades all 8 perks.
Every set: fire and lava can't hurt you, no fall damage, built-in wings.
pages.caption: Smithing table: upgrade, then combine

pages.title: The Crystal Matrix
pages.subtitle: Charge your set
pages.body:
Wear a full set and put crystals {C} into it to unlock its perks one by one. Click a milestone to unlock it.
The counter tracks every crystal you have ever put in.
More charge also means a stronger glow.
pages.caption: Tier 1, tier 2 and Infinity milestones
pages.numbers: Numbers: tier 1 holds {n:crystals_t1} crystals (a perk every 2), tier 2 holds {n:crystals_t2} (every 4), Infinity holds {n:crystals_t3} (every 4). {n:crystals_total} for the whole journey.

pages.title: Astral Armor
pages.subtitle: Tier 1, the builder line
pages.body:
Forged from fallen starlight, it hums with the memory of deep space.
Takes about a third less damage than netherite armor. Fire and lava can't hurt you.
Helmet: breathe underwater forever. Press {key:xray_pulse} to see ores nearby.
Chestplate: built-in wings.
Leggings: move slightly faster. Quantum Tunnel zips you forward in mid-air.
Boots: no fall damage.
Hold jump to jump higher.
Full set (charge with crystals): repairs all your gear over time, sometimes gives back a placed block, longer reach, and items stack higher.
pages.caption: Full Astral set, fully charged
pages.numbers: Numbers: {n:dmg_t1} of netherite damage. X-Ray {n:xray_t1} blocks. Speed +{n:speed_astral}. Tunnel {n:tunnel_t1} blocks, every {n:tunnel_cd_t1}s. Jump up to {n:jump_astral} blocks. Repair 1 durability every {n:repair_t1}s. Block back {n:keep_t1}. Reach +{n:reach_t1}. Stacks 64 to {n:stack64_t1}, 16 to {n:stack16_t1}, 1 to {n:stack1_t1}.

pages.title: Cybernetic Armor
pages.subtitle: Tier 1, the fighter line
pages.body:
Fused with cosmic energy. Everything feels a little... faster.
Takes about a third less damage than netherite armor. Fire and lava can't hurt you.
Helmet: breathe underwater forever. Press {key:xray_pulse} to see ores nearby.
Chestplate: built-in jet wings.
Leggings: faster running speed (your view won't zoom).
Boots: no fall damage.
Full set (charge with crystals): mine faster, jump again in mid-air (wings off), swing swords and draw bows faster, and nearby mobs slow down when you get hit.
pages.caption: Full Cybernetic set, fully charged
pages.numbers: Numbers: {n:dmg_t1} of netherite damage. X-Ray {n:xray_t1} blocks. Speed +{n:speed_cyber}. Mining +{n:mining_t1}. {n:airjumps_t1} air jump. Attack +{n:attack_t1}. Slow {n:slow_t1} for {n:slowdur_t1}s, every {n:slowcd_t1}s, within {n:slow_radius} blocks.

pages.title: Singularity Armor
pages.subtitle: Tier 2, upgrade your Astral armor
pages.body:
Compressed to the point of collapse, it bends gravity around the wearer.
Upgrade your Astral armor with a Singularity template and an ingot. It counts as fully charged Astral and keeps every Astral perk. Crystals upgrade them.
Takes almost half the damage netherite would.
Helmet: X-Ray reaches farther.
Chestplate: built-in wings. Hold {key:flight_thrust} while flying to boost, no rockets needed.
Leggings: move slightly faster, with a longer Quantum Tunnel.
Boots: no fall damage.
Hold jump to jump even higher.
Full set: faster repair, gets blocks back more often, more reach, bigger stacks.
pages.caption: Full Singularity set, fully charged
pages.numbers: Numbers: {n:dmg_t2} of netherite damage. X-Ray {n:xray_t2} blocks. Speed +{n:speed_sing}. Tunnel {n:tunnel_t2} blocks, every {n:tunnel_cd_t2}s. Jump up to {n:jump_sing} blocks. Repair every {n:repair_t2}s. Block back {n:keep_t2}. Reach +{n:reach_t2}. Stacks 64 to {n:stack64_t2}, 16 to {n:stack16_t2}, 1 to {n:stack1_t2}.

pages.title: Cyber Psycho Armor
pages.subtitle: Tier 2, upgrade your Cybernetic armor
pages.body:
Putting this much energy into one suit of armor shouldn't be possible. It's like it knows your movements before you do.
Upgrade your Cybernetic armor with a Cyber Psycho template and an ingot. It counts as fully charged Cybernetic and keeps every Cybernetic perk. Crystals upgrade them.
Takes almost half the damage netherite would.
Helmet: X-Ray reaches farther.
Chestplate: jet wings. Hold {key:flight_thrust} while flying to boost.
Leggings: super fast running speed.
Boots: no fall damage.
Full set: mine faster, more air jumps, much faster attacks, a stronger slow.
pages.caption: Full Cyber Psycho set, fully charged
pages.numbers: Numbers: {n:dmg_t2} of netherite damage. X-Ray {n:xray_t2} blocks. Speed +{n:speed_cp}. Mining +{n:mining_t2}. {n:airjumps_t2} air jumps. Attack +{n:attack_t2}. Slow {n:slow_t2} for {n:slowdur_t2}s, every {n:slowcd_t2}s.

pages.title: Infinity Armor
pages.subtitle: Tier 3, upgrade both lines into one
pages.body:
No edge, no limit — it stretches as far as the wearer dares to go.
Upgrade a Singularity piece with the same Cyber Psycho piece and an ingot. It counts as both lines fully charged and has all 8 perks. Crystals upgrade them to Infinity strength.
Takes half the damage netherite would. Fire, lava and explosions can't hurt you.
Helmet: the widest X-Ray.
Chestplate: hybrid wings. Hold {key:flight_thrust} to boost, no rockets needed.
Leggings: maximum running speed and the longest tunnel.
Boots: no fall damage.
Hold jump to reach ridiculous heights.
Full set: mining, air jumps, attack speed, repair, stacks, slow, blocks back and reach, all at their best.
pages.caption: Full Infinity set, fully charged
pages.numbers: Numbers: {n:dmg_t3} of netherite damage. X-Ray {n:xray_t3} blocks. Speed +{n:speed_inf}. Tunnel {n:tunnel_t3} blocks, every {n:tunnel_cd_t3}s. Jump up to {n:jump_inf} blocks. Mining +{n:mining_t3}. {n:airjumps_t3} air jumps. Attack +{n:attack_t3}. Repair every {n:repair_t3}s. Stacks 64 to {n:stack64_t3}, 16 to {n:stack16_t3}, 1 to {n:stack1_t3}. Slow {n:slow_t3} for {n:slowdur_t3}s, every {n:slowcd_t3}s. Block back {n:keep_t3}. Reach +{n:reach_t3}.

pages.title: Bread Armor
pages.subtitle: A joke set
pages.body:
Made of bread. Really.
It protects about as well as leather and it never breaks.
Craft it from bread like any armor.
pages.caption: Full Bread set

pages.title: Care & Durability
pages.subtitle: Keep your gear working
pages.body:
When a piece is almost broken, its enchantments stop working. Its perks keep going.
Repair it to turn the enchantments back on.
Dyeing never changes perks.
pages.caption: Repair before it breaks
pages.numbers: Numbers: enchantments stop at {n:durability_floor} durability left.

pages.title: Wings & Flight Thrust
pages.subtitle: Fly without rockets
pages.body:
Your wings are on by default. Shift + Right-Click on air with an empty hand to turn them on or off. You can also set a key in Controls.
Tier 2 and 3: hold {key:flight_thrust} while flying to speed up to full elytra speed. No rockets needed.
pages.caption: Infinity wings deployed
pages.numbers: Numbers: Flight Thrust builds up to full speed over {n:thrust_ramp_s}s.

pages.title: Jumping
pages.subtitle: Higher and again
pages.body:
Astral-line boots: tap jump for 1 block, hold it to go higher.
Cyber-line full sets: jump again in mid-air. This only works with your wings off.
Astral, Singularity and Infinity also give you a small push forward in the air.
pages.caption: Boots
pages.numbers: Numbers: hold-jump up to {n:jump_astral} / {n:jump_sing} / {n:jump_inf} blocks (Astral / Singularity / Infinity). Air jumps {n:airjumps_t1} / {n:airjumps_t2} / {n:airjumps_t3} (Cybernetic / Cyber Psycho / Infinity).

pages.title: Quantum Tunnel
pages.subtitle: Zip forward through the air
pages.body:
Astral-line leggings. Press {key:warp} in mid-air to tunnel forward and shoot out the end.
It stops at solid walls.
The key is not set at first. Pick one in Controls.
pages.caption: Leggings

pages.title: X-Ray Pulse
pages.subtitle: See what is hidden
pages.body:
Every Infinium helmet has it.
Press {key:xray_pulse} to show nearby ores and mobs for a moment.
Higher tiers see farther.
pages.caption: Helmet

pages.title: Slow Aura
pages.subtitle: Make them back off
pages.body:
Cyber-line full sets.
When you get hit, nearby mobs slow down for a few seconds.
It needs a short rest before it works again.
pages.caption: Cyber-line full set
pages.numbers: Numbers: {n:slow_t1} / {n:slow_t2} / {n:slow_t3} slower, for {n:slowdur_t1} / {n:slowdur_t2} / {n:slowdur_t3}s, every {n:slowcd_t1} / {n:slowcd_t2} / {n:slowcd_t3}s, within {n:slow_radius} blocks.

pages.title: Sword & Energy Slash
pages.subtitle: Slash, slash, beam
pages.body:
The sword hits hard. Its slashes and beam make enemies bleed, or burn if you wear Cybernetic or Cyber Psycho armor.
Your first two swings send out energy slashes. The third swing fires an energy beam that hits even harder.
Energy mode only works while you wear a full Infinium armor set, and each set has its own slash sounds. A fully charged swing then fires a piercing energy slash.
Without a full set there's no energy slash. It's just a normal sword.
Sneak + Right-Click on air to switch between Energy and Normal mode.
Cyber armor lets you swing faster and hit fast enemies again sooner.
pages.caption: Smithing table
pages.numbers: Numbers: {n:sword_dmg} damage, bleed/burn {n:bleed_s}s (3s Astral/Cybernetic, 4s Singularity/Cyber Psycho, 5s Infinity). Slash deals {n:slash_t1} / {n:slash_t2} / {n:slash_t3} of sword damage by tier.

pages.title: Mining Tools
pages.subtitle: Pick, axe and shovel
pages.body:
Pickaxe: switch between Fortune IV and Silk Touch.
Axe: logs drop the wood type you choose.
Shovel: dig 1x1, 3x3 or 3x1.
Sneak + Right-Click on air to switch modes. Tools copy your armor's look.
pages.caption: Smithing table: netherite tool + ingot

pages.title: Hoe
pages.subtitle: Perfect farmland
pages.body:
Farmland you make stays wet and lit, and it can't be trampled.
Two modes: standard, or hoe a 3x3 area into Infinium farmland at once.
Sneak + Right-Click on air to switch modes.
pages.caption: Infinium Hoe

pages.title: Infinium Rocket
pages.subtitle: One rocket, forever
pages.body:
Put any firework rocket and an ingot in a smithing table.
The Infinium Rocket is never used up.
pages.caption: Smithing table

pages.title: Dye It Your Way
pages.subtitle: Your colors
pages.body:
Put a dye in the template slot and your gear in the base slot. No ingot needed.
Re-dye any time. Dye never changes perks.
pages.caption: Smithing table

pages.title: Settings
pages.subtitle: Make it yours
pages.body:
Click the purple gear next to the recipe book. It shows up once you own a piece.
Turn perks, particles, lighting and sounds on or off for your set.
The World Effects tab has shooting stars, sky ripples and the underwater shimmer.
pages.caption: Particles and wings, on and off

pages.title: Keys & HUD
pages.subtitle: Every key in one place
pages.body:
Wings: Shift + Right-Click on air, or {key:toggle_wings}.
Flight Thrust: {key:flight_thrust}.
Quantum Tunnel: {key:warp}.
X-Ray Pulse: {key:xray_pulse}.
Change any of them in Controls.
The HUD sits top left, below the dungeon timer.
pages.caption: Set keys in Options > Controls

pages.title: Fair Play
pages.subtitle: On servers
pages.body: Some servers limit trading Infinium gear or block certain areas. Ask your server admin if something won't work.
